brief:
Palestinian villages and towns are preparing for the annual olive harvest season, which extends beyond agriculture to form a vital part of the economy, social life and family heritage, Palestine News Network reported. The harvest approaches as farmers face growing challenges in accessing their land during the crucial agricultural period.

Details about the specific obstacles preventing farmers from reaching their groves were not outlined in available reporting.
dek: RAMALLAH, Palestine / PNN / Wisal Abu Alia As the olive harvest season approaches, Palestinian villages and towns are preparing for an annual event that extends far beyond agriculture, forming a vital part of the economy, social life and family heritage.
title: Palestinian farmers struggle to reach olive groves amid growing harvest barriers
